t: A RISC-V AI vision chip for smart cameras, robots and classroom projects.
steps: Buy a CanMV-K230 board or an 01Studio CanMV K230 kit from a maker reseller.
Download the CanMV firmware image and write it to a microSD card.
Insert the card and connect both USB-C cables to your computer.
Install the free CanMV IDE and connect to the board.
Attach the camera and run the camera preview example.
Try the face detection demo and watch boxes appear on screen.
Change the demo to show a message for each face it finds.
meta: Open Board. From $89. A few stores.
